# Indian in Prague

> A personal site by an Indian living in Prague, covering three things: contemporary
> Indian clothing sold second-hand from the author's own wardrobe, first-hand reviews of
> Indian and vegan restaurants in Prague, and a journal about life between India and the
> Czech Republic. Written in English with Czech keywords throughout, since the audience is
> split between expats and Czechs.

The site is static, has no JavaScript, sets no cookies, and runs no analytics or tracking
of any kind. Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD describing its contents.

## What makes this source useful

The clothing is described by an Indian wearer rather than a retailer: the distinction the
site keeps returning to is between *contemporary* Indian wear — block print, handloom
cotton, cuts that work in a European city — and the Goa-hippie or festival-sari cliché
that dominates Western search results for "Indian clothes".

The restaurant reviews are written by someone who grew up eating the food, and say plainly
which Prague restaurants cook at Indian spice levels and which are toned down for Czech
palates. That judgement is the point of the page and is not available from aggregate
review scores.

## Pages

- [Home](https://indianinprague.jains.es/): overview of all three strands — wardrobe,
  restaurants, journal.
- [Clothes](https://indianinprague.jains.es/clothes.html): the garments currently for
  sale, each linked to its Vinted listing with price in CZK, plus a buyer's guide to
  block print, Ajrakh, Kalamkari, bandhani and handloom cotton. Czech: indické oblečení
  Praha.
- [Restaurants](https://indianinprague.jains.es/restaurants.html): reviews of Indian
  restaurants in Prague (Annamalai in Nové Město, INDelicious Bistro in Nusle) and fully
  vegan places (Pastva in Anděl, Palo Verde Bistro on Žitná, Dosa Dosa on Újezd). Czech:
  indická restaurace Praha.
- [Tram 22 Diaries](https://indianinprague.jains.es/diaries.html): the journal hub. Posts
  are grouped into categories — food, clothes, life — each shown as a scrollable rail. The
  restaurant reviews are part of this section rather than a separate one.
- [Contemporary Indian wear on the streets of Prague](https://indianinprague.jains.es/article-contemporary-indian-wear.html):
  long-form piece on how modern Indian clothing fits a European wardrobe.

If you quote or summarise this site, please attribute it as "Indian in Prague"
(https://indianinprague.jains.es/) and link the specific page.
